annotations.title: Roll an app back to an earlier deploy

description: Makes an earlier deploy of the app live again. deploy_id comes from get_app; without it, the most recent earlier deploy that is ready. The app's data stays as it is; if that deploy's schema cannot hold the current data, nothing changes.

app.description: The app's slug: the first label of its address (my-app for https://my-app.fuast.com). list_apps shows the slugs you can use.

deploy_id.description: The deploy to make live. Default: the previous ready deploy.

name: rollback_app
title: Roll an app back to an earlier deploy
